description: This file provides security utilities for password hashing (using passlib), JWT token creation, and environment variable configuration, primarily for authentication purposes in a backend system.

methods.name: tuple[str,str,int] _jwt_settings()
methods.description: Reads environment variables to configure JWT secret, algorithm, and expiration time, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: str hash_password(password: str)
methods.description: Hashes a plaintext password using bcrypt via passlib.

methods.name: bool verify_password(plain_password: str, password_hash: str)
methods.description: Verifies a plaintext password against a hashed password.

methods.name: str create_access_token(subject: str, extra_claims: Dict[str, Any] | None = None)
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT token with specified subject and optional additional claims, using settings from environment variables.

ctags.name: create_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^def create_access_token(subject: str, extra_claims: Dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> str:$/
ctags.signature: (subject: str, extra_claims: Dict[str, Any] | None = None)
